title: Al-Mustasfa min 'Ilm al-Usul
author: al-ghazali
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Ghazali's last and most influential work of legal theory. It opens with a treatise on logic, then orders the discipline around the rule, its sources, the methods of deriving it and the person who derives it, and gives the classic account of the five necessities the law protects.
historicalContext: Written in Tus two years before al-Ghazali's death, after his return to teaching, the Mustasfa became one of the four pillars of the theologians' method in usul and was abridged by Ibn Rushd and al-Razi among others.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
